Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties. This was a metered RYDE_X trip, TRP-02857, driven on 2026-09-09. The booked optimal route was 14.4 km (EV-TRIP-02857). The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02857, weight 1.0), which records 19.12 km against the booked optimal, an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; neither materiality gate (8.0 km, 50%) is met, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation. The trace itself is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 151 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and no jump over 500 m, so the deviation rests on the trace alone (POL-RD-08(b)) and no POL-RD-07(ii)/POL-RD-10(3) corroboration question arises. The triad EV-TRIP-02857 / EV-GPS-02857 / EV-FARE-02857 all carry trip_id TRP-02857 with matching timing, so POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied. No exculpatory clause applies: EV-CHAT-02857 has 0 messages (POL-RD-04 has no instruction to test), no pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X with no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12). POL-RD-11 does not apply because the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-02 runs. The arithmetic, read off EV-FARE-02857: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 surge multiplier (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.832; charged_total 25.93; refund = 25.93 - 20.832 = 5.098, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 19.66% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a full refund. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge lines exist in the ledger, so no POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction is added. On the rider's stated ground: the 'six deviation flags' cited in the claim is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision; the counter POL-RD-06 names, deviation_flags_90d, is 0 against 260 completed trips in the trailing window, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. On the driver's explanation of 'Traffic.': no traffic advisory covers this trip - EV-ADVIS-02857-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and under POL-RD-13 that assertion cites no artifact, so it is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. Two rider claims were discarded before the debate: both cited the impaired advisory EV-ADVIS-02857-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) without disclosing the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The monetary effect (SGD 5.10) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. The 25.93 charged stands except for the 5.10 returned to the rider.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 5.10 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
